action_dictionary.EVIDENCE_FACTS_ONLY_HOLD_FORMAL_EXDATE_E: Record exact primary declared amount/record/pay facts if present; author pass only matches a derived date. Do not treat as fully tradable event,complete cash schedule,or actual ex-date certification.
action_dictionary.LINK_UNMATCHED_DECLARATION_QUARANTINE_DE: No matching amount within author±3-day search is not proof of15 independent missing payments. Link to overlapping candidate; keep alternative amounts and type distinct. No imputed zero,guessed missing dividend insertion or narrowed completeness claim.
action_dictionary.QUARANTINE_AMOUNT_CONFLICT_NO_RATIO_REPA: Do not divide or multiply vendor amount to force agreement. Keep vendor and primary declaration fields separately; adopted D/receivable/cash null until exact event/security/date/unit binding is proved.
action_dictionary.QUARANTINE_EXDATE_CONFLICT_DO_NOT_DEDUPE: Keep 2019-11-28 distinct from2019-11-27. Record amount match and derived-date conflict; no automatic date shift,deletion,orduplicate exemption. Actual ex-date requires its own supported determination.
action_dictionary.QUARANTINE_RETURN_OF_CAPITAL_APPROX_KEEP: Primary kind is return of capital and approx0.14 is not exact vendor0.1405. Keep separate regular0.09 declaration; neither zero it nor sum guessed amounts. If new valuation/tax policy is needed return to author/reviewer for version decision.
action_dictionary.QUARANTINE_SECURITY_LINE_CONFLICT_NO_RET: Block candidate from Barrick consumers. Quarter amount equality is evidence correspondence,not a complete supplier security ID mapping. Do not relabel to Barnes or transfer money to another security automatically.

exdate_proof_policy: Preserve the frozen evidence requirement; no new per-event second-provider/exchange-original hard gate. Supported equivalent rule/settlement-calendar/designated-date branch proof is admissible. The source shortcut used only stock trading dates.
inherited_quarantine_note: Existing COR/CoreSite33,B/Barnes33 and B/Randgold6 constraints remain; Randgold attribution remains inference. Do not treat new40 as replacing prior79 B event records or clearing COR. Do not reopen COST,page-SHA deviation,unit155 or COP actual-exdate decisions.

propagation_rules.rule: For each quarantined event trace every qfq/rehab inverse-price dependency including adjustment anchors outside the event day. If a raw field depends on that event/factor and lacks separately verified range evidence, mark field null with source event lineage. Deleting a cash row alone is not proof raw prices recovered. Unknown ancestry invalidates the declared dependency span; never infer a narrow ex-day-only range.

Propagate unknown event amount/ex-date/security line through analytical C and daily r, every actual recipe lookback,252-session eligibility,20-session dollar ADV, H10 and H5 entry/exit-open valuation and entire entitlement interval, plus train calibration and cross-sectional rankings. New purchase at ex-open has no retroactive dividend entitlement but does not repair its feature/label/history dependencies.

Require separately supported exact amount,type/security identity,actual ex-date and previous-close entitled integer inventory before receivable/NAV adoption. Unknown amount or entitlement=>receivable and NAV null, not zero. Supported receivable with unknown pay availability remains nonspendable; available cash/time null, not written off. No automatic DRIP,free fractional shares,ratio repair,or retyping capital return as ordinary dividend.

Keep VERIFIED_GE50 / VERIFIED_LT50 / UNKNOWN distinct. UNKNOWN freezes optional new risk; it is not a valid empty pool. Missing required labels/calibration or old/new holdings forecast refuses optional P. Do not silently delete B/COR/CEG from frozen64 or manufacture ranks using a convenient remaining subset. Independently required protective actions still require computable data and costs.

Follow all actual dependency descendants through carried holdings,cash,fees,age/risk latches and cross-fold state. If main path is indeterminate retain fold/attempt/date/budget/N identities and null formal affected readouts; no skipped folds,reset capital,concatenation of good slices,or automatic later resumption. Readout impact continues until an independently supported reconciliation checkpoint,not automatically event-day or ten direct windows.

version_impact.different_policy: changing panel,calendar,valuation/type handling,ex-date logic,thresholds,or replacing an unknown with estimate is not a routine input repair; separate version and authority decision required
version_impact.recomputation: any actual source/performance recalculation follows applicable authoritative N and unique historical-run budget; no automatic rerun or reuse of old V/DSR; current static review creates no fictitious trial
version_impact.source_receipts: same frozen definitions may be accepted as versioned v1 inputs after reviewer and engineering adoption; no frozen byte change here
